sentences.japanese: 国王はいつも自分を褒めるおべっか使いにうんざりしていたので彼らを遠くへ飛ばした。
sentences.english: The king was tired of his sycophants always praising him, so he sent them away.

sentences.japanese: みんな彼のことを褒めたたえる。
みんな口を極めて彼女を褒めちぎった。
sentences.english: Everybody praised her to the skies.

sentences.japanese: どの新聞も彼の勇気を褒めたたえた。
sentences.english: His courage was celebrated in all the newspapers.

sentences.japanese: ごめんどうかけてすみません。彼なら何をしても褒められるだろう。
sentences.english: I'm sorry to have troubled you. No matter what he may do, he will be praised.
